```yaml
name: Release Trigger

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: 'Perform a dry run of the release process'
        required: false
        default: 'true'
        type: boolean

jobs:
  trigger-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Trigger Release Workflow
        uses: DataDog/integrations-core/.github/workflows/release-trigger.yml@main
        with:
          dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry-run }}
```
